sloka: यत्ता भवन्तस्तिष्ठन्तु नेतो गन्तव्यमग्रत: ।अहमेव गमिष्यामि सुमन्त्रो गुरुरेव च ॥ २.९३.२५॥
transliteration: yattā bhavantastiṣṭhantu neto gantavyamagrata: ।ahameva gamiṣyāmi sumantro gurureva ca ॥ 2.93.25॥

translations.english: All of you carefully watch here. Do not proceed any further. Sumantra, the preceptor and myself shall go forward.
